title: Crypto ops playbook and automated auditstreams for key lifecycle and residency evidence
creator: Elena Chu
description: Deliver an operational playbook and automated pipeline that produces tamper-evident encryption evidence (key provenance, rotation logs, rewrap audit, and residency bindings) aligned to customer residency and retention controls. The deliverable will: 1) define runbooks for zero-downtime KMS/HSM rotations across regions, 2) implement an "evidence-bundler" service that collects rotation artifacts and signs them for auditor consumption, 3) stream structured audit events to the compliance data lake and 4) expose retention and residency metadata in the Console and API for reporting and enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook drafted and reviewed by Security + SRE: includes step-by-step rotation, rollback, and emergency rewrap procedures
Evidence-bundler service implemented and deployed to staging: collects key IDs, version chain, rotation timestamps, operator identity, region affinity, and HSM attestation statements
Automated reports produced on demand: ZIP package with signed JSON manifest and SHA256 checksums, stored for configured retention windows
Streaming connector verified: audit events land in compliance BigQuery/S3 dataset with schema docs and retention TTL enforcement
No user-facing downtime during scheduled rotations in test harness (validate with 99th percentile latency regression test)
Console shows key residency and retention metadata and exposes an "Export evidence" button that triggers bundling job
tasks: Draft crypto ops playbook (rotation, emergency, multi-region rewrap)
Design evidence-bundler data model and signing format (manifest + signatures)
Implement rotation-orchestrator microservice to coordinate rewrap across model-serving pods and K/V cache drains
Add HSM attestation ingestion: parse HSM-signed provenance blobs and store immutable snapshots
Build streaming connector to compliance data lake (Kafka -> ETL -> BigQuery/S3)
Add Console feature flags/UX: display residency and retention, trigger evidence export
Add end-to-end tests and incident simulation (rotate keys during load)
Write runbooks and oncall playbook for SRE and Security Ops
notes: We need to agree on a canonical manifest schema before the bundler implementation; proposal in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Crypto+Evidence+Manifest
Prefer HSM attestation parsing library from vendor (Thales/CloudHSM) to avoid bespoke parsing bugs; procurement required for Thales test instance
Retention requirements vary by region: EU customers require 7 years for key provenance artifacts vs 3 years for NA by default — product will expose per-customer override
Consider using envelope keys in HSM and rewrap instead of rotating primary data keys to reduce churn in serving runtime
